description: A muted blue-green ankle-length wool apron dress over a cream linen long-sleeved underdress with a modest high rounded neckline, two small simple oval bronze fasteners, a restrained narrow cream geometric woven band at the apron top and sleeve cuffs, a plain brown leather belt and practical soft brown leather ankle shoes fully visible below the hem. Modest prosperous early medieval Scandinavian landowner textile craft, natural lightly worn weave. Civilian clothing only, no head covering, armor, weapons, fur war gear, crowns, emblems or display jewelry.
